project_type: Greenfield Node.js REST API — CRM Sales Management System
build_system: npm — no transpilation, plain JS runs directly with Node. Scripts: 'npm start' (node server.js), 'npm run dev' (nodemon server.js).
test_framework: None initially — manual verification via node -e require checks and npm start smoke test.
test_command: node -e "require('./src/config/database.js'); console.log('modules load OK')" from backend/ after npm install
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend && npm install. 2. Copy .env.example to .env and fill in a MongoDB URI. 3. npm run dev — server should start on PORT without errors. 4. Hit GET /api/auth/me without token → 401. 5. POST /api/auth/register with valid body → 201 with accessToken.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. MongoDB must be accessible (local or Atlas URI in .env). Do NOT commit .env — only .env.example is committed.
contribution_requirements: All files under backend/src/. Entry points are backend/app.js and backend/server.js. Use CommonJS (require/module.exports) throughout — no ES modules. Never return password field in API responses.
key_patterns: Express router files export a Router instance. Services contain all business logic; controllers are thin (call service, send response). All errors thrown as AppError instances and caught by global errorHandler middleware. Mongoose models use timestamps:true. Zod validators used in validate() middleware before controller runs.
directory_structure: backend/ — root with app.js, server.js, package.json, .env.example, README.md. backend/src/config/ — DB + JWT config. backend/src/utils/ — AppError + helpers. backend/src/models/ — 6 Mongoose models. backend/src/middleware/ — auth, errorHandler, validate. backend/src/validators/ — 6 Zod schemas. backend/src/services/ — 8 business logic services. backend/src/controllers/ — 8 thin controllers. backend/src/routes/ — 8 Express routers.
